fields.finding: The +10% area case multiplies film transmission only, leaving film mass, area-dependent outgassing inventory and barrier/attachment mass unchanged. It is a rate sensitivity at fixed inherited geometry, not a complete larger-area assembly. At fixed gauges, 10% more Kapton adds 98.12569224663257 kg; 10% more Zylon adds 21.717480701365734 kg structural fiber and 5.254627872394289 kg barrier/attachment. The Zylon vacuum/barrier/joint-bond subtotal becomes 96.87893676870814–116.87893676870814 kg, leaving only 3.1210632312918616 kg of the 100 kg line at the low bill. These illustrations are not a structural reoptimization.
fields.proposed_next: Label the existing case permeation-only, or consistently propagate actual manufactured area through film, barrier, attachment and release inventories before taking mass or endurance credit.
